description: REQ-LOW-STOCK-ALERT switches from a fixed 10-unit threshold to 5% of each SKU's maximum stock.

proposal.rationale: Merchandising wants a relative threshold per SKU.

patch.body: Merchandising is alerted when on-hand stock of a SKU falls below 5% of that SKU's configured maximum stock. Alerts are produced from the reservation events emitted by CMP-INVENTORY.

acceptance_criteria: An alert is raised when on-hand stock drops below 5% of the SKU's maximum stock
At most one alert per SKU per day
